observations: Full numbered source overlay, all 100 small-component crops and enlarged native faces inspected. Explicit acute tip fragments excluded, while closed eye highlights, ear/nose/mouth details, the 18-pixel architectural triangle and 18-pixel lower hand gap are retained. The pinched upper curved ray reconnects its two main portions and four raster fragments. Central eye crescents and outer eye-white fragments connect only within their own bands; pupils, eye whites and faces stay distinct. Central nostril and short moustache slit, right figure's philtrum and left mouth slit, and a small clasped-finger strip reconnect independently. Other closed facial details remain separate. Castle façades, door arches, columns, flame curls, robe/hood folds and hands retain their pane boundaries. Names distinguish upper ornament/architecture and the left, middle and right figures. No historical identity is inferred. Original ink and prior saved versions remain unchanged.
